description: Backfill one proposal’s screening enrollment on a screening-linked job — the repair for bindingGaps from opentrain_lms_screening_status (proposals that predate the link, or whose fail-soft enrollment at submit did not land). The binding is identical to one created at submit and anchors the applicant on the link’s current published version. Idempotent per proposal (created=false when it already existed); the same key replays the receipt. Typed refusals: 409 SCREENING_NOT_CONFIGURED (no ACTIVE screening link), 409 SCREENING_COURSE_UNPUBLISHED, 400 SCREENING_BINDING_INVALID (not a proposal on this job). Requires confirmAssign=true, an idempotency key, and lms:write.

idempotencyKey.description: Durable-receipt idempotency key: 8-128 characters of letters, digits, dot, underscore, dash, or colon. Same key + same payload replays the stored receipt; same key + changed payload is a 409.

name: opentrain_lms_screening_assign
